interface.shortDescription: MCP apps, host integration and verified handoffs
interface.longDescription: Build or improve interactive MCP apps and their servers, from a clear user task through protocol and host verification. Create a widget that lets someone select, compare or edit real information. Repair state, retries, host messaging and tool contracts in an existing MCP app. Use Alpic deployment workflows when the project actually uses Alpic. Start with a concrete task or ask what this plugin can do. This is a development method package. It does not install a server, create an Alpic account, supply credentials or prove that a host supports every widget feature.
